g.text: AI exposure and observed occupational employment growth
Retrospective comparison of observed employment, not projected employment growth. The line is a descriptive WLS fit.
It differs from the manuscript’s within-high-exposure panel model with occupation/year fixed effects and an exposure-specific trend.
